description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ByteBuffer' that provides methods for byte-level read and write operations, including handling of primitive data types like int and short, with support for getting and putting bytes from and into a buffer. It is intended as a utility class for byte buffer management within a project.

classes.name: ByteBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class providing a byte buffer interface with methods to get and put bytes and primitive types, including buffer state checks such as isEmpty and isFull, as well as utility methods for reading and writing integers and shorts with little-endian format.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty by comparing length to zero.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full by comparing length to size.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Abstract method to get the capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current data length in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the next byte from the buffer, throwing EOFException if empty.

methods.name: get(byte[])
methods.description: Fills the provided byte array with data from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[], int, int)
methods.description: Fills a portion of the provided byte array with data from the buffer.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Abstract method to insert a byte into the buffer, throwing BufferOverflowException if full.

methods.name: put(byte[])
methods.description: Inserts bytes from the provided array into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[], int, int)
methods.description: Inserts a portion of bytes from the provided array into the buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the buffer, resetting its state.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian integer from the buffer.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian short from the buffer.

methods.name: putInt
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian integer into the buffer.
